text:
jia: heads-up — noticed a weird drift where some tenant traffic that should be pinned to v2 starts landing on v1 after ~30s. console shows route switch, quotas get double-counted. :thinking:

alex: hmm, seen anything in routing logs? sample trace? :eyes:

ja: attaching a minimal repro from my workstation. look at the response header TTL vs what the client sends back:
```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer tenant-token" -H "X-Api-Version: v2" https://api.redwood.dev/generate
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Route-Ttl: 30
X-Served-Variant: v2-quant

# subsequent request within 45s from same client shows:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Route-Ttl: 0
X-Served-Variant: v1-legacy
```

sara: is the client dropping the v2 header or are we expiring the session on the edge?

kevin: quick guess — the sticky header TTL is stored in the edge cache tied to the Authorization token, but we recently changed the v2 handshake to issue a separate ephemeral routing cookie with a 30s TTL. clients that proxy/strip cookies will lose the stickiness and fall back. that could explain the switch to v1. quotas end up counted on both because v2 usage isn't aggregated under the same route key.

alex: ah that cookie change — that was the CLI proxy fix last month. ops-bot, any deploys touching routing-cookie logic in the last 7 days?

ops-bot: deploy: routing-edge:release-2026.03.12 applied to edge-north-1 at 2026-03-12T02:14Z by @release-ci

sara: ok, two issues then: 1) cookie-based stickiness is fragile for clients that don't preserve cookies (mobile SDKs, some proxy setups). 2) console/telemetry is not attributing post-fallthrough v1 requests to the original tenant on v2, so billing looks like two tenants.

ja: proposal: revert to header-based long-lived route affinity for v2 tokens (X-Route-Affinity: <hash>) and deprecate ephemeral cookie. fallback: if cookie missing but token seen, use token->route mapping from the central store.

kevin: +1. We should also add a quick dashboard panel: "route-affinity-lost" (rate of requests where v2 token but served-v1). We can surface this as a rollout guard.

alex: action items: 1) kevin to add dashboard panel + alert (P0 warn at 0.5% of requests) 2) devex to publish note for SDKs to preserve headers, 3) infra to roll back ephemeral cookie change or fallback to token->route mapping.

sara: who is devex? jia, can you ping SDK folks?

ja: pinged @s-sdk-team in #devex earlier; leaving a short note and sample repro. also adding a quick canary plan: enable header-affinity in canary tenants only and monitor route-affinity-lost for 1h.

kevin: I'll draft the dashboard and add a short query:
```
sum(rate(requests_total{served_variant=~"v1|v2"} [5m])) by (tenant, served_variant)
|> filter(tenant_has_v2_token and served_variant=="v1")
```

alex: cool. timeline? can we have a rollback/patch in the next 4h? this is impacting quota accounting for a handful of mid-market customers.

ops-bot: incident-note: investigating header vs cookie stickiness issue; tagging teams infra/devex/metrics at priority-high.

sara: if kevin finishes dashboard, i'll coordinate canary and watch the alert. jia, keep repro logs coming.

jia: will do. adding the per-tenant example I saw (sanitized) to the thread. will update with results after canary. :thumbsup:
